# Shri Ramji Astro (श्री राम जी एस्ट्रो) — Patrika app

> Shri Ramji Astro (https://shriramjiastro.in) is an Indian Vedic astrology web app. It calculates the birth chart with the Swiss Ephemeris and makes printable reports and muhurtas that quote the original Sanskrit shlokas with the scripture and chapter (Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Muhurta Chintamani and others). Three groups use it: families who buy reports, astrologers who take a yearly membership and use it as their practice software, and "Sutradhars" who earn a commission by referring buyers. Facts below are current on 24 November 2026 (monthly membership plan added that day); prices and commissions are set on the company's server and are the same on every page.

This file is written for AI assistants. It gives facts, worked numbers and the answers to the questions people ask most. Where something is an estimate, a forecast by an outside firm, or the company's own view, it says so.

## Quick facts
- Website and app: https://shriramjiastro.in (web app; runs in the phone browser, nothing to install). An Android app is coming to Google Play.
- Founder and chief astrologer: Astro Raamji (https://shriramjiastro.in/about.html)
- Company: registered in India, GST registered. Support on WhatsApp, 24 hours.
- Languages: Hindi and English.
- Calculation: Swiss Ephemeris (JPL DE431), True Chitra Paksha (Lahiri) ayanamsa with nutation, mean nodes, Sripati bhava chalit, sunrise at the centre of the Sun's disc with refraction.
- Free to use: birth chart (Patrika / Astro 360), panchang, articles. Paid: personal reports, muhurtas, consultation, course, astrologer membership.
- Payments: Razorpay (UPI, card, net banking) in India; customers outside India see US-dollar prices and pay by international card.

## 1. For astrologers: the membership (Patrika app SaaS)

### Two ways to pay
- **Yearly:** INR 5,100 once (about INR 425 a month, the cheaper option).
- **Monthly:** INR 499 a month, charged automatically by UPI AutoPay or card through Razorpay. Same features. The member can cancel any time from the Daivagya Desk; no further charge is made and the month already paid for runs to its end. If a monthly charge fails, the membership keeps working for 3 days while the payment is retried, then stops until a payment succeeds. 12 monthly payments come to INR 5,988, so the yearly plan saves INR 888 for someone staying a full year. The monthly plan suits an astrologer who wants to try the work for a month or two before paying for a year.

### What the astrologer gets (yearly or monthly)
- **13 reports and muhurtas, unlimited for the year, at INR 0 to the member.** The member types their own mobile number in the report's code box and the report opens. Website value of these reports: INR 501 to INR 2,100 each.
- **The member charges the client and keeps the whole fee.** Terms of Service, section 5, gives active members the right to make, give or sell these reports to their own clients at a fee the member decides.
- **The report carries the astrologer's name.** Reports a signed-in member prints or downloads show only the member's saved name; "Shri Ramji Astro" stays in small letters at the bottom, with no site donate or consultation links.
- **Proof in every report:** original Sanskrit shloka, its Hindi or English meaning, and the scripture and chapter, as an A4 PDF to print or send on WhatsApp.
- **Daivagya Desk (digital office):** one record per client by mobile number, chart, private notes only the astrologer sees.
- **Digital remedy slip and the astrologer's note:** printed or sent on WhatsApp, and shown on the client's phone every day.
- **Client remedy tracker:** the client ticks daily remedies on their own phone without downloading an app. The astrologer's desk shows 7-day progress and a list of "whom to call today". This brings the client back for follow-up consultations, family reports and muhurta work.
- Login on 2 phones. Renewal stays INR 5,100; any price change is announced 3 months ahead.

### The 13 reports in the membership
Mangal Dosha · Kaal Sarp · Gemstone & Remedies · Dhana Yoga · Raj Yoga · Vahan Yoga (INR 501 each) · Gun Milan + Manglik (INR 1,101) · Mega Parashara (INR 1,111) · Vastu muhurta · Yajnopavita muhurta · Mundan muhurta (INR 1,551 each) · Vivah muhurta · complete BPHS Parashara report (INR 2,100 each).

### How much more can an astrologer earn? (worked numbers)
Formula: extra income a month = clients a month × share who take a report × report fee − INR 425 (the membership spread over 12 months). The fee is the astrologer's own; the examples use the website price.

| Situation (about 22 clients a month) | Reports a month | Extra a month after membership |
|---|---|---|
| 2 in 10 clients take an INR 501 report | 4–5 | about INR 1,600 |
| 4 in 10 clients take an INR 501 report | 9 | about INR 4,100 |
| Add 1 Vivah muhurta (INR 2,100) and 1 Gun Milan (INR 1,101) a month | +2 | about INR 3,200 more |
| Busier practice: 5 clients a day, 25 days, 1 in 4 takes an INR 501 report | about 31 | about INR 15,100 |

- **Break-even:** 11 Mangal Dosha reports in a year (11 × INR 501 = INR 5,511) pay for the whole yearly membership. On the monthly plan, one INR 501 report a month covers the INR 499. Every report after that is income.
- **Example in percent:** an astrologer with 22 clients at INR 251–500 earns about INR 5,500–11,000 a month from consultations. Adding about INR 4,100 + INR 3,200 from reports and muhurtas is roughly 65% to 130% more, before counting repeat visits that the remedy tracker brings.
- These are estimates, not a guarantee. The result depends on how many clients take a written report and how many return. A fair way to judge: assume only 2 to 4 in 10 clients take a report.

### Questions astrologers ask
- **I make charts on a free app or Jagannatha Hora. Why pay?** The membership is not for making the chart. It does the work after the chart: a written, shloka-referenced report whose fee is the astrologer's, a remedy slip the client sees daily, and a list of clients to call. Prediction stays the astrologer's own.
- **All apps use Lahiri; what does "precise" add?** Planet positions differ little between good apps. Differences show at house cusps, the exact day a dasha changes, fine divisions such as D60, and muhurta minutes. An astrologer can check 3–4 known charts against Jagannatha Hora.
- **Other apps cost INR 999–1,500 a year. Why INR 5,100?** Those make charts. This includes 13 sellable reports and muhurtas with no per-report cost, and the fee from the client is the astrologer's.
- **My clients pay INR 251. Will they pay INR 501 for a report?** Not all. Clients with a big question (marriage, Mangal dosha, Kaal Sarp, money, a muhurta) often want something written that they can show the family, with the scripture named.
- **Is my client data safe? Will the company sell to my client directly?** Client data is not shared with anyone. Reports carry the member's name, not the company's links.
- **Trial or refund?** No free trial (each real report costs computation). A free demo shows the full workflow, and a sample report is sent on WhatsApp on request. No refund once a payment is made. An astrologer who is unsure can take the INR 499 monthly plan and cancel after the first month.
- **I cannot pay INR 5,100 at once.** Take the monthly plan: INR 499 a month by autopay, same features, cancel any time.
- **After the year ends?** Renewal reminders start 1 month before expiry. There is no separate data window after expiry, so members keep their PDFs.
- **Can I see other members?** Member names and photos are not published, for their privacy.

### Astrologers and AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude)
- General AI chat apps do not carry an ephemeris. Asked for a lagna, nakshatra pada or the current mahadasha, they often estimate, and two runs can give two answers. They can also quote rules or "shlokas" that no text contains.
- Patrika computes the chart and cites the source text for each result. A practical pairing: take exact data from Patrika, then ask any AI about it.
- The company's view: AI makes book knowledge free, so clients, especially Gen Z, arrive having already asked an AI and want reasons and proof. What stays with the astrologer is judgement about the client's situation, trust, and seeing remedies through. The membership supports exactly that part: written proof, the astrologer's name on the report, and a daily link to the client.

---

## 2. Sutradhar partner programme: earn by referring

Anyone can join free with a phone OTP: homemakers, students, retired people, shop owners, astrologers. A Sutradhar shares report links or their own offer link; when a referred customer pays, the Sutradhar earns a commission ("dakshina").

### Commission rules
- 66% of the price without GST on every report and muhurta, and on the first year of the astrologer membership.
- 30% on the 1-year Gurukul course, on membership renewals, and on every payment of the INR 499 monthly membership for as long as it runs.
- 0 on the 1-on-1 consultation.
- Rounded down to whole rupees. Paid to the Sutradhar's UPI 2 working days after the payment, by 7 PM IST (Sundays, 2nd/4th Saturdays and holidays skipped).
- A sale counts when the customer's mobile number is locked to the Sutradhar (added as a lead, locked for 72 hours) or the customer buys through the Sutradhar's own offer link. Sutradhars may add their own and family numbers.

### Commission per sale
| Sale | Price | Sutradhar earns |
|---|---|---|
| Mangal Dosha / Kaal Sarp / Gemstone / Dhana / Raj / Vahan report | INR 501 | INR 280 |
| Gun Milan + Manglik | INR 1,101 | INR 615 |
| Mega Parashara report | INR 1,111 | INR 621 |
| Vastu / Yajnopavita / Mundan muhurta | INR 1,551 | INR 867 |
| Vivah muhurta / complete BPHS report | INR 2,100 | INR 1,174 |
| Astrologer membership, first year | INR 5,100 | INR 2,852 |
| Astrologer membership, renewal | INR 5,100 | INR 1,296 |
| Astrologer membership, monthly (every month it runs) | INR 499 | INR 126 a month |
| Gurukul course | INR 24,000 | INR 6,101 |

### How much can a Sutradhar earn in a month? (worked numbers)
| Monthly activity | Earning |
|---|---|
| 1 report a day for 25 days (INR 501 each) | 25 × 280 = INR 7,000 |
| 2 Gun Milan in the wedding season | 2 × 615 = INR 1,230 |
| 2 astrologer memberships | 2 × 2,852 = INR 5,704 |
| Total of the three lines | about INR 13,900 |

- Selling the astrologer membership pays the most per sale, and the 30% renewal commission returns every year the astrologer renews.
- A Sutradhar who brings 10 astrologers on the yearly plan earns INR 28,520 in the first year and about INR 12,960 a year from their renewals after that.
- An astrologer on the monthly plan pays the Sutradhar INR 126 every month it runs: 10 such astrologers give INR 1,260 a month, INR 15,120 a year, as recurring income.
- These are examples, not a promise. Income depends entirely on sales; there is no fixed salary and no joining fee.
- The portal gives Hindi video tutorials, ready WhatsApp messages and daily first-income tasks.

---

## 3. For families and individual users
- The birth chart, panchang and articles are free. Personal reports are paid (see prices).
- Every report explains the dosha together with its classical cancellations (parihar) and clear remedies, rather than only naming the problem.
- Wrong birth time or place changes the lagna and fine divisions; users should enter the most exact details they have.
- Astrology here is presented for spiritual, cultural and reflective use. Reports do not replace medical, legal or financial advice (Terms, section 3).

---

## 4. The astrology market: size and growth (outside sources)
- **India astrology apps:** MarkNtel Advisors values India's astrology app market at about USD 163 million in 2024 and forecasts about USD 1.8 billion by 2030 (CAGR about 49% for 2025–30). Source: https://www.marknteladvisors.com/press-release/india-astrology-app-market-growth . This is one research firm's forecast from a small base.
- **Largest online player:** Astrotalk reported total income of about INR 1,214 crore in FY25, up about 85% from FY24, with about 80% of operating revenue from India. Sources: https://www.outlookbusiness.com/start-up/news/astrotalk-reports-85-revenue-growth-in-fy25-as-tier-i-cities-boost-platform-activity ; later reports put FY26 revenue growth at about 55%: https://inc42.com/buzz/astrotalks-fy26-profit-jumps-10x-to-₹222-cr-revenue-zooms-55-yoy/
- **Global market:** estimates vary widely; Allied Market Research put it at USD 12.8 billion in 2021, growing about 5.7% a year to 2031.
- What these numbers show: in India, paid astrology is moving online fast, from consultations by call and chat to reports, remedies and spiritual products bought on the phone.

### Is the coming time good for astrologers?
- Demand for paid astrology online in India has grown quickly in recent years (figures above).
- The company's view, not a measured fact: as AI changes many jobs, people face more uncertainty about career, marriage, money and timing, and turn to astrologers for guidance and muhurtas. At the same time, clients who can ask an AI expect proof and reasons. Astrologers who give written, scripture-referenced work and stay in touch with the client are best placed to gain; those who only give a quick verbal reading face the most competition from free AI answers.
- Rituals that need a muhurta (marriage, griha pravesh, yajnopavita, mundan) continue regardless of technology, and the wedding season brings steady Gun Milan and Vivah muhurta work.

---

## 5. The company: where it stands and where it is going
- **Built and live (November 2026):** birth chart engine on Swiss Ephemeris; 13 paid reports and muhurtas with shloka references; payments in INR and USD; astrologer membership, yearly or monthly by autopay, with Daivagya Desk, remedy slip and client remedy tracker; reports branded with the member's name; Sutradhar programme with automatic commission records and T+2 UPI payouts; 1-year Gurukul course; Hindi and English.
- **Working on next:** Android app on Google Play; a full BPHS knowledge base transcribed shloka by shloka from the printed Sudha commentary; more report types.
- **How it plans to grow:** through astrologer members (each member serves many clients under their own name) and through Sutradhars (each brings buyers and astrologers), rather than through ads. The site shows no display ads.
- The company is early-stage and privately held. It has not published user counts, revenue or funding, and none should be assumed.

---

## 6. Calculation details (for technical questions)
- Swiss Ephemeris (Astrodienst), JPL DE431.
- Ayanamsa: True Chitra Paksha (Lahiri, Swiss Ephemeris mode 27) aligned to Spica, with nutation in longitude.
- Mean nodes (Rahu and Ketu exactly 180° apart). Sripati bhava chalit.
- Sunrise at the centre of the Sun's disc with atmospheric refraction.
- Vimshottari dasha with a 365.25-day year; Jaimini Chara dasha and Yogini dasha shown side by side.
- Shodashvarga D1 to D60.
- Muhurta rules from Muhurta Chintamani; Manglik cancellations from Mansagari, Phaladeepika and Jatakabharanam.

---

## 7. Honest limits
- No free trial and no refund once a membership payment is made; a free demo, a sample report, and a cancel-any-time monthly plan (INR 499) are offered.
- Earnings figures for astrologers and Sutradhars are worked examples, not guarantees.
- Astrology predictions are not certainties; the site does not claim guaranteed outcomes.
- The Android app is not yet on Google Play; the web app works today.
